WHAT COUNTS AS COMPLETE

Five moments. One verified outcome.

  1. PayPal captureExact order, learner, course, amount, and currency agree.
  2. AI investigationLedger, Relay, Patch, and Prism cite the saved evidence.
  3. Merchant decisionThe preview shows one grant; approval is tied to that evidence.
  4. Access correctionA single idempotent write changes the purchased entitlement.
  5. Fresh proofThe protected lesson opens; the customer can then confirm their experience.

Technical verification and customer confirmation are separate. A sample story is never presented as a connected PayPal recovery.
